'''Matt LeFontane''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2000 Las Vegas tournament (30 June)]] on 30 June 2000 with EBO X-wings, according to Danny Rider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d956">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-01-vegas-noise-factor-6-30d956/ vegas-noise-factor-6-30], DeckTech (Danny "Skuff D" Rider, 1 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-01-vegas-noise-factor-6-30d956/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
